title: Purple Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Purple Account fees and limits: a $15.00 monthly maintenance fee waived with a $3,750 minimum daily balance, a $20.00 returned deposit fee per unpaid item, and a $0.00 incoming domestic wire transfer fee. It also specifies a $10,000 debit card daily purchase limit and supports 30 foreign currencies in the wallet (exceeding the daily limit causes declines until the next day).
faqs: What is the Purple Account monthly maintenance fee and how can I avoid it?
What is the minimum daily balance required to waive the monthly maintenance fee?

How many foreign currencies can I hold in the wallet?
